raw.query: WITH current_predictors AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'predictors'), scored AS (SELECT variate, model, mode, wape, CASE WHEN model IN ('chronos','toto','timesfm') THEN 'foundation' ELSE 'baseline' END AS family FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE resolution = '1s' AND span = 'common' AND candidate = 'point' AND h = -1 AND model IN ('chronos','toto','timesfm','ewma','naive','holt_winters')) SELECT s.variate, jsonb_object_agg(s.model || '-' || s.mode, round((100.0 * s.wape)::numeric, 3) ORDER BY s.model, s.mode) FILTER (WHERE s.family = 'foundation') AS foundation_wape_pct, jsonb_object_agg(s.model || '-' || s.mode, round((100.0 * s.wape)::numeric, 3) ORDER BY s.model, s.mode) FILTER (WHERE s.family = 'baseline') AS baseline_wape_pct, round((100.0 * min(s.wape) FILTER (WHERE s.family = 'foundation'))::numeric, 3) AS best_foundation_pct, round((100.0 * min(s.wape) FILTER (WHERE s.family = 'baseline'))::numeric, 3) AS best_baseline_pct, cp.n AS current_predictor_runs FROM scored s CROSS JOIN current_predictors cp GROUP BY s.variate, cp.n ORDER BY s.variate
raw.observed: Best foundation/baseline WAPE at 1s: images 98.761%/146.092%; requests 62.911%/68.072%; ctx 86.043%/106.010%; gen 81.631%/99.957%.
raw.claimed: Zero forecast = 100%; at 1s baselines >100% and foundation models approximately 100%.
raw.evidence: The characterization holds for images only: requests, context, and generated-token foundation forecasts beat zero materially, while request and generated-token best baselines are also below 100%.
raw.fix: Scope the sentence to the image signal: at 1-second image bins baselines are worse than zero and the best foundation model is near parity, while the other signals retain forecast skill.
